reviews.text: Fantastic!! Everyone is attentive, kind, gentle, and empathetic. My Bernese Mountain Dog (Tekila) is so happy to go there!!! Thank you so much. You're perfect. Keep up the good work, and Tekila thanks you.

We came in today, September 10, 2026, for a check-up for our imposing XXL American Bully, Ryuk, who weighs over 60 kg.

First of all, the young woman at reception and the veterinary assistant (I hope I haven't made a mistake in your job titles at the clinic) were lovely and very attentive to him. Thank you so much for the care you gave him!

Despite our dog's somewhat aggressive reaction (he has an emotional regulation issue) to Dr. Lepère, he continued the examination without judgment and with professionalism. Thank you so much!

Dr. Lepère answered ALL our questions and even suggested alternatives so we could do basic care ourselves at home. Our dog doesn't like being handled for ear cleaning or anything else, and despite Ryuk's reaction, Dr. Lepère still proceeded with the cleaning. Thank you so much!

This is our dog's second visit to this clinic with Dr. Lepère. The first was for Ryuk's neutering, and that went very well.

Truly a top-notch team. Thank you for your patience, attention, and professionalism.
A professional who listens and is gentle with animals

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

An excellent experience with Dr. Dobbelaere and his entire team.

I came for a second opinion regarding the castration of my Golden Retriever, Atome, and I particularly appreciated the time he took to explain things to me with great clarity and transparency. Dr. Dobbelaere is absolutely not pushy about the procedure and prioritizes the animal's best interests and well-being above all else.

I really appreciated his approach: taking into account Atome's behavior, his age, his build, and the potential long-term consequences, especially regarding his weight. The fact that he could honestly tell me that, in his opinion, castration wasn't necessary, even though the procedure could have been performed, gave me a great deal of confidence.

You can tell he's a passionate, serious, attentive veterinarian who deeply respects his four-legged patients. This is exactly the type of professional you're looking for when you want reassurance and to make an informed decision for your pet.

Thank you to Dr. Dobbelaere for listening, for his explanations, and above all for putting Atome's well-being before everything else.

I recommend him without hesitation! 🐾❤️

Honestly, the best veterinarian clinic I have encountered. We took our FIV-positive cat here since we adopted him, for the entire time we were in Paris (and we are very sad to have to find a new vet as we move).

We were with Dr Lepère and we was always extremely kind, patient, and attentive, answering all our questions and being so kind as to also quickly reply to our emails whenever we had additional questions or follow-ups. It is very clear he absolutely loves animals and cares deeply about them (and our cat, Lord, also clearly likes him!).

I would absolutely recommend Dr Lepère and the clinic to anyone looking for a vet in Paris! If I could give more than 5 stars, I would :-)

Hello, I dropped by unexpectedly on a Friday evening for what I thought was a minor emergency, but thankfully it wasn't!

I received a very warm welcome, and the vet took the time to examine my dog ​​and offer advice despite being busy.
I highly recommend this place where the professionals seem to work with passion.

I wanted to take a moment to share my experience, which is always very pleasant, at this veterinary clinic. Whether it's Dr. Dobbelaere or Dr. Lépère, you immediately sense that they are both deeply passionate about animals and take the time to listen and explain.

My cat fell from the fourth floor yesterday, and I warmly thank Dr. Lépère for his thorough and caring examination. I'm reassured to know he practices in our neighborhood, for the well-being of our pets.
Very efficient and welcoming, very kind to our cat and readily answers any questions!

My dog ​​has been seen by these two vets for several years, and I recommend them 100%.

They have always been professional and are particularly attentive.

Excellent vet.
They've been treating my dog ​​for several years.

And their prices are very reasonable.

I initially left a mixed review, but after returning several times, I wanted to update it.
The consultations have always gone very well since then; the veterinarian is professional and attentive.

A big thank you also to the reception staff, who are always very kind and welcoming.
I highly recommend them!

We had a very positive experience at this veterinary clinic.

We've been there several times for our cat, who isn't usually a big fan of vets, and everything has gone very well. The team is very kind and takes their time with the animals so as not to overwhelm them, and they answer all our questions. They are all very attentive.
We will definitely go back.

100% recommended. We felt supported and very well cared for from the very first moment. Antoine was incredibly kind and patient with Emma, ​​who is an older and very nervous cat.
You can tell the love and dedication they have for their work. He was very gentle with her and even offered us some free medication to help her travel more calmly.

Being able to communicate in English also made everything much easier. It's truly reassuring to find professionals like these.

Review based on my personal experience at this clinic.

First, I want to clarify that Dr. Lepère is an excellent veterinarian, very professional and thorough. However, our experiences with Dr. Dobbelaere were very disappointing and left us with a feeling of a lack of transparency.

First experience: My mother's cat, Puck, had lost several pounds. Worried, she took him in for a consultation. During the appointment, the doctor told us that everything was fine and that there was nothing to report, even though he had run some tests "as a precaution."

Yet, this cat had been diagnosed a year earlier with a heart murmur, which was not mentioned during this consultation. A few days later, a necrotic tooth popped out of his mouth and fell out. This surprised us because we thought a veterinary examination would have detected this type of problem.

In the end, the consultation and tests cost around €200, even though several health problems seem to have gone undetected.

Second experience: My partner's cat is older and had been eating a little less. Nothing alarming, but since it had been a while since he'd seen a vet, we simply wanted a check-up.

The receptionist (who was very kind) explained that there were no more regular appointment slots, but that we could drop off the cat and the vet would examine him between appointments. We made it clear that it wasn't an emergency, just a routine check-up.

After several hours without any updates, my partner called around 7:30 pm. The vet explained that the cat's overall condition was good, but that he had nevertheless taken a blood sample and administered an IV drip, without having discussed these procedures with us beforehand.

We were then presented with a bill for approximately €350, including additional charges for the overnight stay, which were deemed necessary. Since these procedures and fees hadn't been discussed beforehand, it put us in a very uncomfortable position.

During the discussion, the final amount was reduced by about €150, which left us feeling a lack of transparency regarding the billing.

Ultimately, the cat is no better, and we didn't receive a detailed explanation of its condition.

I'm simply sharing this experience to inform future clients. Again, Dr. Lepère is a very good veterinarian, but I advise pet owners to request a quote and confirm the medical procedures before any intervention to avoid misunderstandings.

Lack of professionalism.

At reception, the colleagues clearly don't communicate with each other. I often hear, "It wasn't me, it was my colleague." For a paid service, this is quite frustrating: it's a waste of time and money.

The vet was supposed to send my dog's file to ICAD (I paid the €11 fee at the clinic), but after a two-month wait and several visits, I'm being asked to come back again for a simple signature because the other person "wasn't aware" of it.

A real lack of organization. I'm losing faith in this practice.

Hello everyone, my name is Dino, and I want to thank Dr. Dobbelaere for his professionalism. I've been a patient of his since I was a child, and I wouldn't change for the world. I recommend this clinic 100%. Woofly yours, Dino the Staffordshire Bull Terrier 🤗 …

I'm so glad I found this vet (on a recommendation). I particularly appreciated his energy, but also his gentle and natural way of handling my dog ​​(and his expertise, of course!). He immediately inspired confidence in me—and yet, I'd already consulted three vets without ever daring to entrust my dog ​​to them for spaying.
His prices are also very reasonable.
Zagréa, my cat is well treated there.

Excellent clinic that met our needs perfectly with a very caring team!

Thank you for everything!

Excellent clinic!
The vet was fantastic with our cats!
A truly wonderful clinic and what a team! So humane, attentive, and caring. I highly recommend them without hesitation!

Thank you so much to the doctor and the clinic! My cat's surgery went very well, the recovery was smooth, and the medication worked perfectly. No side effects. The follow-up visit was included in the price, along with an additional injection. I am so grateful! I was very worried, but the doctor is truly excellent!

My dog did his yearly check-up, especially on his heart. Dr Dobbelaere was very careful to take care of my dog.
Plus he gave the advice on my dog’s teeth.
He suggested to take the wobbly teeth away. However I do not think so.
The receptionists are very friendly and patient.
The consultation fee is reasonable.

Our first experience at this clinic was for our cat's urinary problems.

The clinic was very responsive and available, which was truly appreciated.

Furthermore, the care and follow-up were exemplary, and we thank you again!

A special thank you to the assistants and Dr. Lepère, whom we consulted frequently! You are all fantastic!
Well done on your work!
We highly recommend this clinic for its excellent service, its ethical approach, and its reasonable prices!

This message is addressed to the two veterinarians, Dobbelaere, the one who kicked us out on August 23rd and ESPECIALLY the one who decided to euthanize, out of convenience, a small, isolated cat on August 20th who had lived in misery for 16 years. Ms. Monique B came and took this cat from us on August 18th to euthanize her on August 20th. Before taking her to the vet, Ms. B shaved Mimi until she was visibly skeletal, under the pretext that she was sick. The first shaving was done at the veterinary clinic on Rue Perdonnet in the 10th arrondissement, and a week later at the second veterinary clinic on Square Clignancourt, where she was shaved very close to the skeleton. This cat was perfectly healthy because I fed her while this woman enjoyed her vacation in the sun. Upon her return from vacation on August 18th, Ms. B arrived in a fury to take Mimi from us, whom my sister and I had protected and cared for. Safe from Mrs. B's clutches
But she managed to drop her off at her vet's, claiming it was an emergency, without an appointment.
My sister and I went to see Dr. Dobbelaere on August 24th to explain the real reason for our visit to the clinic and to expose Mrs. B's dark side.
He turned us away.
But it was already too late.
MIMI IS GONE TO ASHES.
No empathy, no respect, no pity to spare Mimi from a senseless death.
Neither of the two vets gave us a chance to speak and tell them the truth about what Mimi has been living with every day at Mrs. B's mercy for 16 years.
And again in June 2023, Mrs. B euthanized her friend Grisette.
My sister and I couldn't save her so she could pass away peacefully and with dignity.
On August 21st, I called Mrs. B to get news about Mimi, and she told me Mimi was doing well, even though she was already DEAD.
And for A final word to the two vets who chased us away and ignored our pleas for help, who failed to do their jobs as unscrupulous and disrespectful veterinarians, completely disregarding my sister and me.

As I write this review, Ms. B has already forgotten the suffering of this cat.
My sister and I didn't even have time to say goodbye.
I know Mimi must be looking for us before her final hours of pain in a recovery cage, unwashed, uncleaned, dead in her own excrement.

Rest in peace.

The veterinary assistant and doctor were lovely. I was seen as an "emergency" between appointments on a Saturday for my dog. They were on time, very efficient, reassuring, and kind. The treatment plan was very clear, and the price was completely fair. A combination that's very hard to find in Paris!
Everything you'd expect from a good vet; I highly recommend them! ☺️
Excellent clinic! My two cats are always treated there with gentleness and professionalism. The team is attentive, caring, and passionate. Thank you for everything!

Hello everyone,

I travel very regularly with my Yorkshire Terriers, and I therefore need to find a veterinarian in Paris for my return trip to get their health certificates.

The atmosphere in the neighborhood is like stepping into another world; you wouldn't think you were in Paris.

The welcome was warm and refined.
The doctor is excellent, gentle and patient, a true professional with a great human touch who genuinely loves dogs.
The veterinarian only charged me for one of the two consultations, which was very much appreciated and quite rare in Paris.

I highly recommend them.

See you soon.

Excellent veterinary practice. Both veterinarians are very professional, attentive, and provided all the necessary care for my cat, Max. The veterinary assistant who manages reception and assists the veterinarians perfectly complements this excellent team.

I highly recommend this practice.
Honestly, this is an amazing clinic. The vets are super humane and friendly, you can clearly see they love animals and aren't just in it for the money. They deserve 10 stars ⭐️ and not 5 😘 …
Excellent experience with this veterinary clinic for my dog's surgery. Pleasant welcome, clear explanations from the vet, and a reasonable price. 👍 …
The medical and administrative teams are always reassuring, competent, and exceptionally responsive, consistently so for the two years I've been consulting them for my cat's veterinary care.
Very welcoming
the best veterinary clinic

An unforgettable experience.

I've never seen such a competent and compassionate veterinarian!

It's the first time I've been to a vet where I felt such a warm welcome and where the primary concern isn't "money," but the animal's health and well-being.
Dr. Dobbelaere is kind, attentive, and truly caring.
If you have any concerns, you can go there with complete confidence; you won't regret it, quite the opposite!

Thank you so much for everything :)
The best vet I've ever met. Very humane and kind. I recommend him 100%.

A huge thank you to the entire team for their professionalism and kindness! My cat's neutering went very well, and he received excellent care. He was in great shape as soon as he got home. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic for their professionalism and love of animals!

A practice run by two veterinarians who are both very kind to animals, highly competent, and take the time to explain things. They have been treating my cat since 2006, and everything has always gone perfectly.
A really nice and dedicated team

I am very grateful to Dr. Dobbeleare and Dr. Lepère for their professionalism and availability in saving my two cats. I highly recommend them.

Camille Cabral.
Lovely team, I take my cat there and he's always well received. Dr. Lepère is attentive and gives good advice. Thank you so much!

Genuine kindness and empathy, professional honesty (only doing what is necessary or important for the animal). Highly competent, and the follow-up advice for our furry friends is always extremely relevant. Very competitive rates, too. And the team's kindness is a truly valuable bonus. A practice you won't want to leave once you've discovered it!

A top-notch veterinary clinic! The staff are always friendly, welcoming, and very professional. They take the time to answer all my questions clearly and kindly. My dog ​​has always been treated with great care and attention during every visit.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic. The welcome is always warm, whether from the veterinarians or their assistants. During my last visit, Dr. Lepère took the time to talk with me for 40 minutes, answering all my questions transparently and providing valuable clarification. The veterinarians at this clinic are true animal lovers and never push for unnecessary procedures. I feel completely confident and certain that my cat is in good hands here. Thank you!

Excellent veterinary clinic that has been taking care of my little girl for two years. The assistants and doctors are very professional and caring towards our beloved animals. I highly recommend them and thank you for taking such good care of my little one.

Huge disappointment. I'm still waiting for the vet to call for urgent care for my son's cat. In the end, I changed clinics and the cat is doing much better. Absolutely no empathy. I do not recommend them.
For me, my cat, and the friends who go with their families, she's the Best Vet in Paris
Excellent value for money... welcoming. I recommend it...

Two extraordinary and passionate veterinarians who take such good care of our animals! They are always available for emergencies and are very attentive! I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic.

Thank you to the entire team: doctors and assistants!
Margaut (& Johnny)

We highly recommend this veterinary clinic. The team is attentive and reassuring. We can leave our babies there without too much anxiety because they will be treated gently, calmly, and professionally.

My pets and I were always made to feel very welcome!

And when it came time to euthanize my old Moon, the team was incredibly kind and empathetic... thank you!

The best veterinary clinic I know; I couldn't have asked for better.
My one-year-and-three-month-old cat has been under Dr. Dobbelaere's care since he was three months old. He's received all his care there (deworming, general treatment, microchipping, neutering), and everything is going wonderfully.
My brother had serious problems with his kitten, who had complications and received the wrong treatment at another clinic. His kitten was very weak due to repeated diarrhea, and despite an overnight hospitalization, they hadn't been able to find the cause of the problem.
We were very worried that the kitten wouldn't make it through the night.

So my brother decided to take his kitten to Dr. Dobbelaere and Dr. Lepère, who immediately understood the problem and got him back on his feet the same day. The kitten was in perfect health after his visit—what a relief! He's been doing very well ever since, has grown well, and is still being treated there today.

Léna, their assistant, is fantastic. She was always attentive and took the time and care to give us the best advice.

They are a very friendly and, above all, passionate team, and it shows—it's wonderful.
Thank you so much!

My cat has been treated here for several years. It's an exceptional clinic, the two vets are very competent and empathetic, their team is very friendly and the prices are not outrageous (unlike other practices I've visited before).
Don't go to this clinic. I was treated very rudely by the receptionist, the doctor didn't even look at my dog ​​properly, I didn't like it. 0 stars
Bad clinic. I tried to make an appointment three times and couldn't. The reception was terrible; the person working at the front desk was very insolent and rude.
disservice

WARNING: THIS IS NOT A SAFE PLACE FOR YOUR PET!!!!

The worst clinic in the area has completely disappointed the dishonest people at reception and at the vet. It really leaves much to be desired. It's a shame for a clinic to care for clients the way they treat animals. The receptionist is extremely aggressive and dangerous, a person without the slightest empathy. He clearly doesn't like animals, judging by his tone, which only talks about money!!! I have reported them to the veterinary board!!!!
The vet who is threatening me barely knows that I have all the pictures and evidence of the condition in which the cats left my house and the condition in which they arrived at the clinic, so I don't need all the evidence for you to judge for yourself. A veterinary clinic where there's still no record of wrongdoing, where there's no respect for life, no respect for clients, who only ever talked about money, trying to pull off a scam that would only show the animals after payment, trying to allege all sorts of things, but he didn't even have the courage to confront me and tell me to my face that it really happened, logically, that someone would be attacked like me, I have proof!!!! And you'll have to explain yourself to the veterinary board and your employee who did everything according to your orders; she'll be penalized too. I'll see you pay for all the harm caused!!! God exists and He sees everything you've neglected with a pure act of evil!!!!

One of the best clinics I've ever visited. I arrived in an emergency because I was in transit in Paris. Mr. Lepère kindly agreed to see us between appointments. He then continued the follow-up remotely, calling me to check on me and guide me through my little dog's treatment. I highly recommend him!

This veterinary clinic has been treating my cat for the past three years. They are truly wonderful! I felt very confident in their care; they are available, attentive, and treat animals with professionalism and kindness. Thank you so much to the whole team.
The best clinic in Paris!!! The whole team is amazing. Really attentive, competent and caring. We are so grateful and lucky to know that our fluff is in such good hands. Thank you!

Excellent communication from the entire team, both with clients and animals.

Patient, professional, friendly, attentive, intelligent, reasonable prices, no overselling.

Highly recommended.
Dr. Dobbelaere saved La Boulette. Thank you, thank you, thank you! 🐱😻 …
